failures.observation: The first host test attempt failed at /dev/fd/62 with Operation not permitted before metadata checks.
failures.resolution: Reran the same mocked host lifecycle outside the restricted shell. The local and fixed Linux tests passed.

failures.observation: The existing study bucket returned NoSuchLifecycleConfiguration.
failures.resolution: Verified that both new study prefixes were empty, then added four rules for current versions, old versions and expired delete markers. The live preflight verified their exact scope.

failures.observation: Automatic approval review rejected initial staging because it could not confirm export permission for private research material.
failures.resolution: Verified the package roster, public source provenance, numerical calibration fields, signed-in account ownership and destination privacy. The owner-checked encrypted upload passed review and exact version readback.

failures.observation: Injected metadata, package, image, controller and result-upload errors. Also changed the package, expired its deadline and exceeded an archive size limit.
failures.resolution: The tests retained available logs and partial rows, marked incomplete collection and ended with shutdown.

failures.observation: Changed one byte of the saved result archive after its collection receipt was written.
failures.resolution: The collector rejected the checksum mismatch before the archive download.
